_about: Sir William Hamilton, Bart. (1788-1856), the Edinburgh logician, raw IA OCR: Lectures on Metaphysics and Logic, edited by Henry L. Mansel and John Veitch, the authorized American edition (Boston: Gould and Lincoln; vol. I Metaphysics 1859, vol. II Logic 1860). His edition of Reid's Works is on thomas-reid and his Stewart on dugald-stewart. US public domain. No uids minted.
